remarks:
Welcome to 8714 Hayes Hollow Road in beautiful Colden! This is such a unique property and one that I think is going to really stand out. You get a quaint two-bedroom home with an incredible 83 acres of land in one of the most desirable areas to settle in.

The kitchen is HUGE and honestly, it is just begging for someone who loves to bake, cook, garden, or wants to embrace the homesteading lifestyle. There is so much space to work with and so much potential to make it the heart of the home.

The spacious living room opens right into the dining room, making it a great space for entertaining or just hanging out with family. There is also a nice at-home office, which is perfect if you work from home or need a quiet space for hobbies or projects.

And then there are the 83 acres! The land is surprisingly easy to walk and enjoy, with plenty of room to explore, hike, hunt, garden, or simply enjoy the privacy and beauty that comes with owning this much property. There is something really special about being able to step outside your door and have all of this land to call your own.

If you've been looking for a place where you can slow down, have some space, enjoy the outdoors, and really make a property your own, this could be it. 83 acres in Colden with a charming home and so much potential is a pretty rare find. Come take a walk around and see what you think — I have a feeling you're going to fall in love with it! Open House Sunday 9.6.26 11-1
